documents.title: Board Meeting - Financial Results/Other business matters
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported strong Q1 FY27 financial performance with significant year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by new product launches and operational efficiency. Management expects the full-year revenue growth to be sustained at 25% to 30%, supported by ongoing new product introductions in the premium and value segments. The company is actively expanding its B2C presence on platforms like Flipkart and Amazon and plans to introduce higher-value clocks priced between Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000.

guidance.claim: Management stated that full-year growth is expected to be 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue for the next quarter to be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the first quarter reflected strong operational performance and broad demand across the product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed a slight negative impact on exports due to price increases.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

demand_outlook.claim: Export demand has been affected by logistic problems due to the war scenario.
The company has a good order book including corporate orders.
demand_outlook.quote: We also have a lot of corporate orders.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that margins are fluctuating due to daily increases and decreases in raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.
Yes, raw material cost has increased.

margins_costs.claim: Freight costs have increased due to the war scenario.
margins_costs.quote: Due to this war scenario, the freight cost has increased.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is running at 60% to 70% quarter-to-quarter.
The company has many export orders that are pending for shipment.
orders_capacity.quote: Now, we have a lot of orders for export, but some orders are pending because, goods are ready, but shipment is not happening.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated there is no requirement for additional borrowing to fund future growth at present.
Debtors for 2024-25 were Rs. 10 crore and for 2025-26 were Rs. 6.73 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: 2024-25 debtors is Rs. 10 crore and 2025-26, debtors is only Rs. 6.73 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The working capital cycle is 29 days for debtors and 37 days for creditors.
capital_allocation.quote: Our working capital cycle is of 29 days for debtors.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that exports are going down due to increases in price.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

risks_headwinds.claim: Margin has been impacted due to market competition, raw material price increases, and war situations in geographies.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, sir, because market’s competition and revenue has increased, but margin has not increased because of so many problems in raw material price increase and this situation of war in geographies.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to develop items in the Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 price range during FY 2027-28.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
